assertions: R2 separates durable capability accession from ordinary research programmes.
Operator scale motive is frozen as longer populations, separately authorised cross-asset populations, separately authorised multiclock populations and portable specialised research.
IROF is reused as the generic execution/checkpoint/capacity plane; no duplicate generic runner is proposed.
Current C2 owner structural-snapshot read surface is a handoff requirement and is not reconstructed by LSIAC.
RRSCG is decomposed into R2 constraint kernel, D9 observer-state dynamics and narrow D10 reducer rather than imported monolithically.
Multiclock inheritance preserves clock identity and negative claim caps rather than creating a shared categorical phase ontology.
Representation Robustness and named Observer-State Geometry nomination are excluded from accession as ordinary/future research subjects.
No authority expansion is created by the review.

routing_correction.reason: The first workflow attempt correctly failed closed before repository test shards because the permanent PR lacked detached exact-head VIT qualification. This was a transport-metadata defect, not a scientific or review defect.
routing_correction.remediation: Canonical payload-only VIT lineage and detached exact-head qualification were published without changing the R2 scientific scope.

final_closeout_head_rule: Because this QA record, delegated decision and programme-state transition are themselves part of closeout, the final PR head must receive a fresh detached VIT qualification and repeat required exact-head repository assurance before the decision may become effective.
